title: [DEV] Overlapping temp basals in history possibly causing wrong IOB
symptom: Temp basals are not cancelling correctly or not showing up in history, causing overlapping temp basals and wrong IOB results. The IOB counter for a temp basal was still going up every 5 min even after it should have ended.
cause: Overlapping temp basals in history, possibly due to a bug in the pump driver, leading to incorrect IOB calculations.
fix: Fixed by a commit referenced in the thread: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/d261bbad09a04d854ee3169eaf927f5502d8c7a2
